RETURN: queue for the 湖滨 / 一公园 boat (check the Chinese sign) - NOT 中山公园. Ferry ~15 min, then walk ~300m south on 湖滨路 to Hyatt 湖滨28 (~5 min) for 12:30. FALLBACK: if no 湖滨 boat, return to 中山公园码头 and DiDi ~10-15 min to 湖滨路28号.

Pagoda is lit after dark - you will see it from the lake tonight. · GETTING THERE: DiDi from Hyatt 湖滨28 south along 湖滨路/南山路, ~4km / 10-15 min (~¥15), drop at 雷峰塔景区 南山路 entrance.
